en: Colorized panoramic view over a spa town set in a valley with wooded hills around it. Large multi‑story spa hotels and residential buildings cluster along the slopes, with a long colonnaded building in the foreground labeled as the Mühlbrunnen. The caption in German identifies the scene as a panoramic view of Karlsbad, Westend, and the Mühlbrunnen. The card is printed in an old-fashioned style with red serif text and a blank lower area for writing.
